display_name: PAMF 七方法论文及补充对比矩阵
description: 发布 Receiver-Agnostic RFFI r04 和 STAR-RFFI 的匹配训练与读出，汇总全部七种识别方法。
authorization: 2026-11-26 用户要求直接启动，覆盖原论文矩阵、Word 补充实验和其他方法所缺行。

data.version: Retained paper and advisor Phase1 handles
data.representation: FP32 2x256 eq1 IQ, unchanged source ID and labels
data.physical_ids_ref: Exact per-setting L_s/U_s/V metadata and validated target prediction indices
data.train_ratio: Paper panel natural or 1/5/10% labels; advisor panel exact original budgets
data.support_query_ref: Only fixed Phase1 test handles; no support
data.leo_config_ref: Source practical residual and validated clean plus six practical

permissions.external_method_exception: r04 supervised learner; STAR source-only capped pseudo-labels. Fixed matched DURA-LU at paper evaluation.
permissions.claim_scope: Single-packet source-only WiSig domain generalization on simulated practical channels

checkpoint.initialization: Scratch on each new split. Main exact frozen output reuse.

sources.selection: fixed E100 EMA, all three exact finished rows
fixed E50 r04, all three saved source weights

checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Historical weights are reused only on their exact source contract.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E50 Shen and fixed E100 STAR; no target feedback

execution.gpu_policy: Up to 4 own GPU workers, one per card, candidate cards (2, 6, 7, 5, 3, 1, 0, 4). Actual free-memory admission. One CPU scorer and one source cache job.
execution.stop_rule: Fail closed on illegal input or wrong frozen identities; keep healthy tasks and stop affected method/stage after two failures.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent CPU scorer after all row decisions freeze.

notes: Receiver-Agnostic RFFI is the paper's method name. Fixed WiSig recipe is r04 paper_pdp_half.
Eleven paper source settings with three paired seeds; twenty-four advisor settings with one seed; natural five-source point is a common-six-receiver aggregation.
All 228 existing four-method rows and 57 existing PAMF rows passed scores coverage and truth-last check; no duplicate training or scoring of those rows.
Main reuses three STAR results and three r04 weights plus raw cross-RX/cross-both decisions. Three r04 Main readout extensions and 108 scratch rows are scheduled.
Supplements include all three joint L+V budgets, 16 equal-size receiver combinations and five date holdout or forward settings. Internal PAMF/DURA structure ablations retain their own method matrix.
Receiver-Agnostic RFFI retains the 0.68 practical TX CE and source-only r04 PDP/AWGN. STAR retains the fixed paired-view recipe. A one-RX domain head has one class.
